name: member_read-savings-balance
description:
Look up a member by their 6-digit member number in CoreVue and return the current balance of their S1 savings share account.

May return these business outcomes instead of a result: MEMBER_NOT_FOUND (No member record exists with that member number. This is a legitimate answer, not a failure.); MEMBER_NUMBER_INVALID (The member number was rejected by the application's own validation.); ACCESS_DENIED (The operator's role is not authorised to view this member record.).

memberId.description: The member's 6-digit CoreVue member number. (pii — redacted in all logs)

returns.savingsBalance: money — Current balance of the S1 savings share account, without the currency symbol.

outcomes.description: No member record exists with that member number. This is a legitimate answer, not a failure.
The member number was rejected by the application's own validation.
The operator's role is not authorised to view this member record.
